subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "Has he left already?"

options.text: She asked if he had left already.
She asked had he left already.
she asked whether had he left already.
She said if he had left already.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked if he had left already.
